subject: Superintendent Roy Belson Retirement Agreement
overview: The School Committee approved a retirement and transition agreement with Superintendent Roy Belson and adopted an updated district incident report policy following community concerns over school safety.

items.title: Public Comment on School Safety
items.summary: Students and community members addressed the committee regarding school safety concerns, communication protocols, and upcoming student demonstrations.

items.title: Superintendent Retirement Agreement and Safety Directives
items.summary: Approved a mutual retirement agreement for Superintendent Roy Belson effective April 30, established conditions for interim operations and post-retirement transition consulting, and announced planned security audits and safety initiatives.

items.title: Incident Report Policy
items.summary: Approved a revised district incident report policy as amended to incorporate the policy into annual reviews, school facility rental contracts, and student handbooks.

items.title: Superintendent and Committee Member Remarks
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson apologized for recent actions and community disruption, and school committee members delivered statements reflecting on district leadership and school safety.
